sources.entry: Baidu Wenku AI - Smart PPT generation and document writing. #free

summary.name: 百度文库
summary.one_liner: Baidu Wenku is Baidu's online document library and platform for searching, downloading, converting and creating documents, slides and knowledge bases, with AI writing and PPT generation tools.
use_cases: generate a PowerPoint presentation with AI
draft a long-form document such as an employee handbook
search and download reference documents and exam papers
organize files into shared knowledge bases
summary.what_it_does: The page is the Baidu Wenku web homepage, showing an AI assistant box (库库AI) for writing and Q&A, and tools for AI PPT, smart writing, AI drawing, document conversion and mind maps. It offers a search of document libraries and a file upload area (up to 100 files, 200 MB each; word, pdf, excel, txt and image formats). Users can create new Word, Excel, PPT or canvas files, and browse curated knowledge bases and templates. The page also mentions a content creation centre for publishing documents and earning content revenue.
notable: Built-in AI assistant (库库AI) and AI PPT generation
Upload limit of 100 files, 200 MB each, with Word, PDF, Excel, TXT and image support
Large library of user-published documents, knowledge bases and templates
Document format conversion and mind map tools
caveats: Membership (开通会员) is needed for some benefits such as AI creation and document resources, per the page
Login is required to view member benefits and some features
Content is user-published and quality varies; the page does not state terms for downloads
